about: Every reference page consulted while deriving docs/contract.json. VCF Automation ships no machine-readable API specification, so each contract fact below is traceable to a specific reference page on the Broadcom Developer Portal (developer.broadcom.com/xapis) or, where noted, to the module manifest that proves a PowerCLI SDK gap.
referenceSet: developer.broadcom.com xAPIs, "latest" channel, which served VCF Automation 9.1 on the fetch date

sources.usedFor: Discovery: enumerating the VCF Automation API families (VM Apps Org - Project / Catalog / Deployment, All Apps Org, VCF Automation - Consumption). Establishes that VCF Automation is documented as a set of reference guides, not as a downloadable specification.
Operation getAllProjects: method, path, and the complete documented query-parameter set. Confirms there is no server-side name filter, so a caller must match project names client-side.
Fields of a project record (id, name, description, orgId, administrators, members) used to shape the getAllProjects response.
Authoritative list of catalog-item operations and their canonical paths, including POST /catalog/api/items/{id}/request.
Operation getCatalogItems: method, path, documented query parameters (including search and projects) and the PageCatalogItem response name.

Operation requestCatalogItemInstances: path parameter, the full CatalogItemRequest body schema (every field optional, with maxLength on deploymentName and reason), the CatalogItemRequestResponse array response, the documented status codes, and bearerAuth.
Fields of a catalog item (id, name, projectIds, type, isRequestable, bulkRequestLimit, ...) used to shape the getCatalogItems response.
Confirms the request response carries only deploymentId and deploymentName, which is why the deployment identifier must be captured from this call and never re-derived later.
Authoritative list of deployment operations and canonical paths, including GET /deployments/{deploymentId}/resources and DELETE /deployments/{deploymentId}.

Consulted for context on the /deployment/api base path and deployment filtering. Not part of the contract: the change flow learns its deployment identifier from the catalog request response instead of searching for it.

Operation getDeploymentResources: method, path, documented query parameters (including the names filter and its defaults) and the PageDeploymentResource response, whose entries carry id, name, type, state and currentRequest.
Authoritative list of day-2 action operations, establishing POST /deployments/{deploymentId}/resources/{resourceId}/requests as the resource-level day-2 submission path.

Operation submitResourceActionRequest: both path parameters, the full ResourceActionRequest body schema (actionId, inputs, reason - all optional), the Request response, and the documented status codes including 409 Conflict for a request-state conflict.

The bearer token the VCF Automation calls carry is obtained from SDDC Manager. Fixes the request body fields (username, password, apiKey, idToken) and the 201 response (accessToken, refreshToken.id) that the shipped VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager code path relies on.

sources.documents: VCF.PowerCLI 9.1 module manifest and dependency list
sources.usedFor: Evidence for the gap this module fills: VCF PowerCLI 9.1 ships VMware.Sdk.Vcf.CloudBuilder, VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer, VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops and VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager, and no generated bindings for VCF Automation. Also pins the prerequisite module version.
